summary: An excerpt from a fiction book (Book 1, part 133) in which a teenage hacker known as M1k3y answers questions from journalists after a terrorist attack on San Francisco. M1k3y criticizes the Department of Homeland Security as failing to protect people and terrifying them, and describes technical tricks, such as building an Internet the government cannot wiretap and jamming person-tracking technology, that M1k3y figured out alone. The passage ends with M1k3y handing the keyboard to Ange and with Marcus's personal troubles, suspension from school and fights with his dad, sketched briefly.
one_line: A teenage hacker called M1k3y fields journalists' questions after a San Francisco attack, criticizing the DHS as failing and terrifying citizens.
key_facts: M1k3y is a 17-year-old who says they are not a straight-A student but figured out how to make an Internet that the government cannot wiretap.
M1k3y says they figured out how to jam the DHS's person-tracking technology.
M1k3y claims they can turn innocent people into suspects and guilty people into innocents in the eyes of the government.
M1k3y says they could get metal onto an airplane or beat a no-fly list.
Doug Christensen identifies himself as being from the Washington Internet Daily and asks what the DHS should do to prevent another attack on San Francisco.
M1k3y says that if the DHS's job is to keep people safe, the DHS is failing, because none of its actions would stop the bridge from being blown up again.
M1k3y states: "The point of terrorism is to terrify us. The DHS terrifies me."
M1k3y says: "if this is a free country then I should be able to at least say what my own cops do to me."
A journalist from the Sydney Morning Herald asks M1k3y questions during the press exchange.
M1k3y says "If I can do it, terrorists can do it."
M1k3y asks "Do you feel safe?" after explaining that the government said it took away freedoms to make people safe.
Some people in the exchange say that terrorists and the government are the same, either literally or in being equally bad.
Some people say the government knows how to catch terrorists but prefers not to because "war presidents" get re-elected.
The movement's names listed include Xnet, Little Brothers, Little Sisters, and the United States of America.
When M1k3y got tired, M1k3y handed the keyboard to Ange, who spoke as M1k3y for a while.
Marcus was suspended from school, fought with his dad, and wondered about his situation.
